title: Misleading $9.99 weekly subscription
body: My 78-year-old father accidentally downloaded this app after tapping an ad. The first screen uses a huge “Continue” button while the $9.99/week price appears in much smaller gray text. He opened the app once, could not use it, and was charged weekly for two months. Be very careful before tapping Continue.
